title: Department of Animal Services / Fiscal Year 2027-28 Budget Request for Positions to Support Animal Welfare at Skid Row
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Department of Animal Services to include a request for two additional positions dedicated to Skid Row in their FY 2027-28 proposed budget proposal as follows: One Animal Control Officer to extend enforcement and field coverage to more days of the week, expand the Department's reach in the community, and improve outreach alongside City departments and community organizations; and One Management Analyst to coordinate community partners, outreach, and clinic schedules, manage donations and grants, track service and case data, and serve as the point of contact for Council District 14 stakeholders. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council instruct the City Administrative Officer, with the assistance of the Department of Animal Services, to report within 30 days on the associated costs of these positions, use of these classifications, and the feasibility of authorizing these positions through resolution authority in the current fiscal year.
